name: Three Cities Guest House, Cospicua
h1: Three Cities Guest House in Cospicua, Malta
meta: A family-run guest house in Cospicua (Bormla), next to the Valletta ferry. Five private ensuite rooms, shared kitchen and a rooftop with Grand Harbour views. Book direct.
intro: A family-run guest house in Cospicua, one of the Three Cities, right next to the ferry that crosses to Valletta in ten minutes and a few steps from the American University of Malta. Five private rooms, each with its own bathroom and air conditioning, a shared kitchen, and a rooftop terrace with views over the Grand Harbour.
shared: Supermarkets, restaurants and the sea within walking distance

name: Jungle Palazzo, Senglea
h1: Jungle Palazzo guest house in Senglea, Malta
meta: Jungle Palazzo is an old palazzo in the heart of Senglea renovated into a stylish five-room guest house. Private ensuite rooms, high ceilings, shared kitchen. Book direct.
intro: An old palazzo in the heart of Senglea, renovated into a stylish guest house with five private rooms. High ceilings, bold design, a stylish shared lounge and a kitchen on the ground floor, with AC and heating included in every room. The Senglea waterfront, the Gardjola Gardens viewpoint and the ferry to Valletta are a few minutes on foot.
shared: Shared kitchen on the ground floor
AC and heating in every room
Bus or ferry to Valletta in 10 minutes

name: Sliema Townhouse Rooms
h1: Private rooms in a Sliema townhouse, Malta
meta: Two private rooms in a unique townhouse in central Sliema with a shared new kitchen, backyard BBQ and rooftop terrace. Five minutes from Exiles beach. Book direct.
intro: Two private rooms in a unique townhouse in a quiet street of central Sliema, mixing modern and traditional. Guests share a brand-new kitchen with washing machine and tumble dryer, a backyard with a big BBQ and a rooftop terrace with a chill-out area and gym equipment. Exiles beach is five minutes on foot.
